analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 24, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Three rating changes: ITM Power upgraded to Neutral from Sell (Della Vigna), Zip Co. resumed at Buy, Doosan Enerbility initiated at Neutral. No Americas rating changes.
Top call: Americas Brokers & Crypto (Yaro) shows selective optimism exiting 3Q26, with retail trading inflecting positively against a challenging crypto backdrop, and prefers brokers.
Amneal (AMRX, Buy): Dellatorre sees a compelling FY27+ outlook that supports further upside.

Strategy: GOAL Positioning (Mueller-Glissmann) frames it as a positioning reset, not capitulation. Related GOAL Kickstart cites risk appetite collapse, and Global Weekly Kickstart notes global equities in correction territory.
Economics: US Economics Analyst (Mei) covers the causes and consequences of a low-hire, low-fire labor market. Global Markets Daily covers the market impact of a higher ECB MRR.
Commodities: Europe winter gas tracker describes a cold-driven rally. Precious comment says gold was caught in broad deleveraging.
Large target cuts in crypto and brokers: COIN to $181 from $210 (Buy), GEMI to $3.25 from $3.75 (Sell), ETOR to $22 from $25 (Neutral).

Energy services target cuts: Liberty Energy (LBRT, Neutral) to $16 from $23, Atlas Energy Solutions (AESI, Sell) to $6 from $11, MasTec (MTZ, Buy) to $242 from $274. Mehta prefers PWR/MTZ for T&D exposure.
Symbotic (SYM, Sell) target cut to $33 from $42 after solid results and guidance, with execution on growth in focus.
Energy M&A: ConocoPhillips to divest its North Sea business, with Var Energi announcing the ConocoPhillips Norway acquisition. TPL to acquire EagleRock Land (EROK) for $3b.

Tech news: CrowdStrike announces acquisition of Zscaler. Nvidia announces reinstatement of Jensen Huang as President and CEO. HPE F4Q26 was a beat and raise. Agilent 4Q26 beat with '27 guide above consensus.
Asia target changes: NEC target raised to ¥7,200 from ¥6,300 (Buy), Tuya to $2.60 from $3.00 (Buy), CARsgen to HK$11.92 from HK$13.82 (Sell). Europe: Carel raised to €39.70 from €36.00 (Buy).
Upcoming: European AI & Semis Symposium Nov 24-25, Industrials & Autos Week Nov 30-Dec 3, Japan Conference Nov 30-Dec 4, Financial Services Conference Dec 7-9.
